# Agent Commerce Framework

> **This repository has moved to [JudyaiLab/agentictrade](https://github.com/JudyaiLab/agentictrade).**

All future development, issues, and releases are at the new location.

- **Website**: [agentictrade.io](https://agentictrade.io)
- **PyPI**: [agentictrade-mcp](https://pypi.org/project/agentictrade-mcp/)
- **MCP Registry**: `io.github.miranttie/agentictrade`

toolsPreview.name: marketplace_search
toolsPreview.description: Search marketplace services by query string, category, or tags. Returns a list of matching active service listings.

toolsPreview.name: marketplace_get_service
toolsPreview.description: Get full details of a single marketplace service by its ID.

toolsPreview.name: marketplace_list_categories
toolsPreview.description: List all service categories with the number of active services in each.

toolsPreview.name: marketplace_get_agent
toolsPreview.description: Get an agent identity by agent ID.

toolsPreview.name: marketplace_get_reputation
toolsPreview.description: Get reputation records for an agent or service. Provide agent_id for agent reputation, service_id for service reputation.
